text_block_list.text:
Blazing through at top speed, Daiichi Ruby 
shines with supreme radiance. Her 
brilliance captivated not only the 
audience, but even her fierce rivals.

She knows what the ultimate brilliance 
truly is. It is the noble light that 
serves as a beacon for all. And to be that 
light is the mission of her family—

Seeking to reach that state of mind, she 
set her next sights on the Sprinters 
Stakes. Without realizing it, her heart 
was burning with passion.

A few days later, Daiichi Ruby learned 
that K.S. Miracle, known for her 
terrifying speed, would also be entering 
the Sprinters Stakes—
